name: Kinaxis
notes:
Scope + policy populated 2026-08-05 from the Bugcrowd brief. In-scope patterns: *.kinaxis.com/*, *.kinaxis.net/*, *.ai.kinaxis.net, *vpn*.kinaxis.com (the vpn pattern is covered by *.kinaxis.com). STRICT ALLOWLIST: anything not matching these is out of scope and must not be tested (subdomains, internal corp infra, customer/vendor systems, employee endpoints, third-party services like kinaxis.okta.com / kinaxis.sharepoint.com).

AUTOMATION: Unlike a 'no automated scanning' program, Kinaxis PERMITS automated testing — active types are enabled. BUT prohibited: DoS/DDoS/network DoS, load & stress testing, ANY high-volume request generation, rate-limiting attacks/bypass, email bombing, all social engineering, phishing. Testing is on PRODUCTION: do not compromise stability/integrity, do not touch other users' data (use a second @bugcrowdninja.com account), do not delete/edit site data. Port scanning left OUT of allowed_test_types to avoid aggressive network scans on prod — add back with light timing if needed. THROTTLE playbooks (low rps + jitter) to stay clear of the volumetric prohibitions.

*** REPORTING: The program REJECTS 'low-effort or AI-generated content'. bb-beast's LLM layers (triage, exploit_smith, exploit_guide) are for the OPERATOR'S internal analysis ONLY — do NOT paste their output into a submission. Every report must be original human analysis with role used, clear impact, and detailed repro. One vulnerability per report; chained vulns allowed in one report if linkage is explained. Multiple paths/params/environments = duplicates. ***

FOCUS AREAS: internal data exposure (config/creds/API keys/employee/proprietary data via public endpoints), customer PII exposure (unauth), subdomain takeover (*.kinaxis.com pointing to unclaimed GitHub Pages/Azure/GCP), sensitive file/dir exposure (.env, .git, backups, config, DB dumps), unauthenticated API data leakage, security misconfiguration. Testing is not limited to these. If post-exploitation could modify/destroy data, STOP and report. Safe Harbor: authorized under CFAA, good-faith research protected. Credentials: none provided; create accounts with @bugcrowdninja.com. Confirm the exact engagement URL and whether compensation is cash vs points-based (relevant to F-1 non-monetary constraint) before engaging.
